name: Lightish Red
lede: Lightish Red is a bright pink-red recorded in Wikipedia's color lists and the 2010 xkcd survey, with two near-duplicate names only a little over a unit away.

sections.title: A hedged build on red
sections.body:
The nearest named colors on file are [[neon-red]], [[watermelon]], [[light-red]] and [[pink-red]], at 3, 3.1, 3.5 and 3.7 ΔE [1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes the hue as deep yellowish pink, about 7.9 units from that block's center, more pink than the name's own word red suggests [1]. Its Munsell notation is 4.9R 5.5/17.6 and its LCH values are lightness 56, chroma 84, hue 26 degrees, a highly saturated color [1]. 

Two near-duplicates sit close by: Pinky Red, 1.1 units off, and Red Salsa, 1.4 units off [2]. See [[red]] for the primary color this hedged name only lightly adjusts. A fifth, slightly farther neighbor is [[imperial-red]], 4.7 ΔE away, darker [1]. Further out still, [[pinkish-red]] sits 4.7 ΔE away, darker [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of Lightish Red covering even 1% of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole: a color this saturated and this pink is uncommon in aged oil paint [3].
